import { describe, it } from 'node:test'
import assert from 'node:assert/strict'

// A note that mentions skip and only in a comment.
describe('math', () => {
  it('should add', () => {
    const label = 'skip this .only in a string'
    assert.equal(1 + 1, 2, label)
  })

  it('should await a matcher', async () => {
    await expect(Promise.resolve(1)).resolves.toBe(1)
  })
})
